what.text: This page follows refugees from Myanmar living in Thailand, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 80411 refugees from Myanmar in Thailand, 5.3% of all refugees from Myanmar.
Bangladesh hosts by far the most refugees from Myanmar, followed by Malaysia, Thailand and India.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over Karen territory in Myanmar in many years from 1988, most recently with the KNU from 2021 to 2025.
It also records armed conflict over Shan territory in several periods from 1988 to 2015, and over Kachin territory with the KIO.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1993 at 82289 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 135476, at the end of 2013, and was lower by the end of 2025; the main years of displacement in the data run from 1993 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Thailand.
These are year-end totals for Thailand only, reported to UNHCR.
